title: Microsoft Goes Its Own Way, Acquisitions Pile Up
desc: Microsoft pitches homegrown MAI models on its own Maia chips as a cheaper alternative to OpenAI and Anthropic, while Cognition, World Labs, and Midjourney all announce acquisitions in the same week.

title: Models Multiply, Wall Street Wobbles, Agents Get Real
desc: Claude Opus 5 tops the agentic leaderboard, Kimi rattles chip stocks, and agent infrastructure quietly matures with knowledge layers and on-device runtimes.

title: Open Models Just Ate the Frontier's Lunch
desc: Chinese open-weight models overtake US labs on downloads, Kimi K3 spooks chip stocks, and OpenAI answers with a three-tier GPT-5.6 family.

title: GPT-5.6 Lands, Agents Get Memory, Banks Cut Headcount
desc: OpenAI ships a three-tier model family and a real-time voice model, Microsoft and AgentPrizm push agent infrastructure toward production, and PayPal's AI turnaround plan costs 4,500 jobs.

title: Chips Get Personal, Money Chases Inference, Agents Play Games
desc: Anthropic and OpenAI both move toward custom chips, Baseten raises $1.5B for inference infra, and Meta ships a weird mini-game generator.

title: Giants Sprint, Labs Poach, Agents Ship
desc: Model releases collide at the frontier, a Nobel laureate defects to Anthropic, and the agent framework era officially matures.
